sections.heading: No-Claim Bonus for Claim-Free Years
sections.text: If you do not raise any claims during your policy tenure, you are rewarded with a no-claim bonus. This benefit helps reduce your future premium outgo or enhances coverage, encouraging long-term policy continuity while keeping costs under control.

sections.heading: Portability Without Losing Accrued Benefits
sections.text: If you are insured under another health insurance policy, you can switch to this plan while retaining accrued benefits such as waiting‑period credits (and other continuity benefits), subject to regulatory guidelines. This allows flexibility without compromising continuity.

sections.heading: Discounts That Reduce Overall Premium Cost
sections.text: Opting for longer policy durations or family coverage helps you save through multiple discounts, including family and long‑term policy discounts, co‑payment discounts, and other applicable offers.

sections.heading: Secure Payment
sections.text:

sections.heading: What is a pre-existing disease clause in a individual Medical insurance policy?
sections.text: A pre-existing disease clause in your individual medical insurance plan refers to health conditions diagnosed before you bought the policy. These are important because there's a set waiting period before claims become active for these conditions. Stating them at the time of purchase works in your favour as transparency ensures quick claims.

chunks.heading: What is a pre-existing disease clause in a individual Medical insurance policy?
chunks.text: A pre-existing disease clause in your individual medical insurance plan refers to health conditions diagnosed before you bought the policy. These are important because there's a set waiting period before claims become active for these conditions. Stating them at the time of purchase works in your favour as transparency ensures quick claims.
